messages.subject: [Basta-users] Convergence
messages.body_plain:
Maybe you have other issues, not necessarily quality of data, which is more like a philosophical thing, you can try with large burn ins, or better, larger thinning?
I have some serious issues in the past and saw a paper (cannot tell the exact one, it was seabirds, using BaSTA, in JAE) with huge thinning, and that worked for me too.

best
Fer
